description.zh: 根据记忆系统插件开发，不能与记忆系统插件同时启用。使用Material Design重构UI。实现按角色卡隔离记忆功能。并基于角色卡ID、Persona目录和Operit原生Memory Profile提供角色长期记忆、隔离召回、Prompt注入与角色管理界面；记忆注入采用官方额外信息注入插件方案，可在设置页开关并选择是否随消息保存。
description.en: Developed based on the memory system plugin; cannot be enabled simultaneously with it. UI rebuilt with Material Design. Implements character-card-scoped memory isolation, and provides character long-term memory, isolated recall, prompt injection, and character management UI through character card ID, Persona folders, and Operit native Memory Profiles. Memory injection follows the official extra-info injection plugin scheme, togglable in settings with an option for whether injected content is persisted with the message.

description.zh: 可选：界面状态保存文件路径；默认使用系统数据目录中的last_ui_state.json。
description.en: Optional UI state file path; defaults to last_ui_state.json.

description.zh: 分析生活与角色记忆，并通过Operit原生Memory与Persona目录隔离角色数据
description.en: Analyze life and character memories with isolation through Operit native Memory and persona folders
